# Agent Mainframe (amf)

> A terminal dashboard (Rust TUI) for running many AI coding agents in
> parallel — Claude Code, Codex, and Opencode — each on its own git
> branch and tmux session. Watch every agent from one place, jump into
> whichever needs attention, and get notified the moment one is waiting
> for input.

Key features:

- Multi-agent workspace manager for Claude Code, Codex, and Opencode
- Project/feature tree with per-feature git worktrees and tmux sessions
- Embedded tmux view with live ANSI rendering inside the TUI
- Vibe modes (Vibeless diff-review, Vibe, SuperVibe) for permission control
- Local-only hooks and notifications; global settings are never modified
- Machine-friendly automation commands with JSON request/response

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/eldridgerdev/agent-mainframe/blob/main/README.md): Install, quick start, keybindings, configuration, themes, and architecture
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/eldridgerdev/agent-mainframe/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): Architecture and module map for working in the codebase
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/eldridgerdev/agent-mainframe/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Guidance for AI agents contributing to the project

## Guides

- [Docker without system tmux](https://github.com/eldridgerdev/agent-mainframe/blob/main/docs/docker-no-tmux.md): Run AMF in a container where the tmux package is not preinstalled

## Automation

- [Automation overview](https://github.com/eldridgerdev/agent-mainframe/blob/main/docs/automation/README.md): External-agent commands for creating projects, features, and batch features with JSON responses
- [create-project example](https://github.com/eldridgerdev/agent-mainframe/blob/main/docs/automation/create-project.example.json): Sample payload for `amf automation create-project`
- [create-feature example](https://github.com/eldridgerdev/agent-mainframe/blob/main/docs/automation/create-feature.example.json): Sample payload for `amf automation create-feature`
- [create-batch-features example](https://github.com/eldridgerdev/agent-mainframe/blob/main/docs/automation/create-batch-features.example.json): Sample payload for `amf automation create-batch-features`
